_readme: The hand-maintained half of the named index. Derived from CONSENT-LEDGER.md — that file is the source of truth for what anyone agreed to; this one only makes it machine-checkable. NO NAME APPEARS HERE THAT THE LEDGER DOES NOT ALREADY NAME IN COMMITTED TEXT: this repository is PUBLIC, so adding a withheld name here would publish it. Every other subject carries nameWithheldFromRegistry:true and its name strings come from a local overlay that is never committed (see src/Core.TypeScript/book-index/README.md). Missing overlay is reported as UNCHECKED, never as a pass.

subjects.scopeNote: glass-halo (self) — his own mind, transparent by his choice. He is in the index because his footprint is what every other subject's passage sits beside, not because his consent is in question.

Personal-relation naming PERMITTED where Aaron places it; professional / technical-source attribution DENIED (employer confidentiality). This registry enforces the STRICTER half (no name) because a machine cannot tell which register a sentence is in. It does NOT enforce the ledger's open question about the ROLE framing ('a UX-research mentor') surviving without her name — that is Aaron's call and is unresolved.

subjects.scopeNote: ASKED 2026-08-25, awaiting reply. Role-only until she answers. The teaching value of the episode is entirely in Aaron's half and every word survives with her unnamed. Naming her would also further identify the son the ledger omits. No role phrase is registered deliberately: the ledger and the local memory both refer to her only by role in context, and inventing a detector phrase here would be the shadow introducing a reference she has not agreed to.

Standing rule, not a consent question: kept out of the text regardless of what anyone says. Minors cannot consent, and consent cannot be purchased or induced. This is the one row the shadow will not cross regardless of instruction.
